pages.text: Gears wear out. Flesh heals. I will not $(o)build$() machines; I will $(o)grow$() them.$(br2)First, a frame of $(l)Brass Armature$() in whatever shape I like. Then a $(l)Culture$(), set into the frame. Then I feed it.

pages.title: Brass
pages.text: Copper turns green and soft with time. Flesh does not trust it. $(l)Brass$() holds: three parts copper to one of gold, crushed together into a $(l)Brass Blend$() and smelted.$(br2)Nine ingots make a block; nine nuggets an ingot.

A culture is rotten flesh, bone meal and a $(l)full vial$() of one essence. Awareness cultures need a $(l)Preserved Brain$() instead (zombie villagers and witches carry them).$(br2)Use the culture on an armature block. That block becomes the organism's $(l)core$().
pages.title: Cultures

pages.text: Feed it essence of its own kind: right-click any part of it with a vial. It $(o)hungers$(). Fed essence becomes growth: flesh creeps over the frame, block by block. When the frame is full, it stores the rest.$(br2)It must eat regularly. Starved, it eats itself back to bare copper, and then it dies.
pages.title: Hunger
